Senior Data Analyst — Keystone Logistics (Hybrid, Chicago)

About us: Keystone runs 40 regional warehouses and a fleet of 600 trucks moving freight for retailers across the Midwest. Our analytics team of six supports operations, finance and sales, and we are rebuilding our reporting on Snowflake.

What you'll do
- Own reporting and analysis for warehouse operations: throughput, dock-to-stock time, labor productivity, on-time shipments and claims.
- Build and maintain data models in Snowflake and dbt; improve performance of slow queries over large shipment and inventory tables.
- Partner with the demand planning team on weekly demand forecasts by warehouse and customer, and track forecast accuracy.
- Design Power BI dashboards for operations leaders and present insights monthly to the VP of Operations.
- Investigate data issues end to end across our WMS, TMS and ERP sources and fix root causes, not symptoms.
- Mentor two junior analysts and help set team standards for SQL, testing and documentation.

What you bring
- 4+ years in data analytics, ideally in logistics, supply chain, retail or operations.
- Advanced SQL; hands-on Snowflake and dbt experience.
- Strong Power BI (DAX, data modeling) skills.
- Experience with forecasting concepts and measuring forecast accuracy (MAPE, bias).
- Comfortable working independently in an environment where data is spread across several systems and documentation is thin.
- Clear communicator who can explain analysis to operations managers and executives.

Nice to have: Python, Airflow, experience with warehouse management systems, SnowPro certification.
